title: onecam beat sheet
description: A continuous-camera film as data. The camera path is derived from these beats; it is never hand-keyed. Gate 1 approves this document.

pace.description: Scales every distance-derived travel time. Below 1 is faster, above 1 is slower.

motionFloor.description: Amplitude of the residual camera drift that guarantees standard M1. Scale to the scene's world units.

beats.description: In order. The camera travels to each in turn and never cuts.

position.description: Camera position [x, y, z] in world units.

travel.description: Seconds to reach this beat. Omit to derive it from distance — recommended, because pinning it is how inconsistent speed creeps in.

hold.description: Seconds held on this beat while its content plays. The camera still drifts.

curve.description: Override the distance-derived curve. Use sparingly; the default exists to stop every move sharing one easing.

content.description: What happens on screen during this beat. Prose, for the Gate 1 review.

narration.description: The line spoken over this beat. Counts toward the on-screen word budget when captioned.
